headline: SFG @ ARI matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SFG 4.17 at ARI 3.47, with a projected total of 7.63. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward SFG: SFG moved +0.47 runs while ARI moved -1.33, changing the projected margin by +1.80 runs. The projected total fell -0.86, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -26.2%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Robbie Ray has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Willy Adames, Rafael Devers, Luis Arraez, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Adrian Del Castillo, Bryce Eldridge because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
